summary: Iteration 2: focused verification of the FLT2_4.1 data-completeness bug fix. Added 2 new pytest cases (FLT2_4.1 full 16-component check + 8060522_1 regression) — all 9 backend tests pass. Ran Playwright E2E on the public URL: FLT2_4.1 now returns Total Groups=2, Total Components=16, Active Materials=16, results table renders exactly 16 rows with correct Line Item sequence (10 in group 10; 10,20,30..150 in group 20), Material ID, Quantity=1, UOM=EA, ECO values (FLT2_4.3 / 696603163_1) and 16 green 'Yes' Active badges. Regression: 8060522_1 still returns 10 rows / 2 groups. Invalid BOM 'INVALID_BOM_999' still surfaces the bom-search-error-alert. 'SAP Connected' indicator renders on load. No console / page errors. The previously-noted 'Line Item' column bug from iteration_1 is also fixed — line item now shows per-component sequence (10,20,30...) instead of duplicating group number.
test_credentials: N/A - no app auth. SAP creds in backend/.env.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for FLT2_4.1 (positional zip replaced with ObjectID+0x4000 direct-key lookup) is fully verified end-to-end. Backend pytest suite now has 9 tests covering root, connection status, valid/invalid/missing/empty/whitespace BOM search, FLT2_4.1 completeness, and 8060522_1 regression. Known accepted limitation: FLT2_4.1 group 20 shows Material ID='FLT2' for all 15 sub-rows due to SAP AssignedVariant field limitation in this tenant — per problem statement this is expected and NOT a bug.
